meta.name: claw-heartbeat-delegation
meta.description:
Task delegation to the heartbeat agent via HEARTBEAT.md.
Use when scheduling follow-ups, recurring checks, or recording background jobs for later monitoring.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 通过心跳文件自动委派任务和定时检查
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要通过文件机制调度周期性任务和跟进事项。
copy.tagline_en: Delegate tasks and schedule recurring checks via heartbeat file.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to schedule recurring tasks and follow-ups via a file-based delegation system.

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会通过 HEARTBEAT.md 文件将一次性或重复性任务委托给心跳代理，自己只读取状态，不执行任务。
howto.when: 当需要安排后续跟进、定期检查或记录后台任务时触发。

say.text: 帮我安排一个明天下午3点的跟进任务。
设置一个每日检查服务器状态的重复任务。
记录这个后台任务到 HEARTBEAT.md。
say.note: Claude 会记录后台任务信息供心跳代理监控。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude delegates one-time or recurring tasks to the heartbeat agent via HEARTBEAT.md, only reading status without executing tasks.
howto.when_en: Triggered when scheduling follow-ups, recurring checks, or recording background jobs for later monitoring.

say_en.text: Schedule a follow-up task for tomorrow at 3 PM.
say_en.note: Claude records the one-time task in HEARTBEAT.md.

say_en.text: Set up a daily server status check.
say_en.note: Claude adds an entry under Recurring in HEARTBEAT.md.

say_en.text: Log this background job to HEARTBEAT.md.
say_en.note: Claude records job info for heartbeat agent monitoring.
